question: By how many percentage points did the surface fluorine mass ratio fall through the Cyrene-based separation?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page = 5 AND id IN ('p5.L16','p5.L17','p5.L18','p5.L19') OR (page=5 AND text ILIKE '%fluorine%')
SELECT ROUND(12.49 - 0.14, 2) AS diff, (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L17') AS l17, (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L18') AS l18

SELECT ROUND(CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L17'), '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)%', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L18'), '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)%', 1) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS drop_pp

SELECT ROUND(CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)%', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)%', 1) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS drop_pp FROM lines a, lines b WHERE a.id='p5.L17' AND b.id='p5.L18'
